Equiv.piCongrRight:
def VTask.piCongrRight {α : Sort u_1} {β₁ : α → Sort u_9} {β₂ : α → Sort u_10} (F : (a : α) → β₁ a ≃ β₂ a) : ((a : α) → β₁ a) ≃ ((a : α) → β₂ a) :=
  {
    toFun := fun f a => (F a).toFun (f a)
    invFun := fun f a => (F a).invFun (f a)
    left_inv := by
      intro f
      funext a
      have h₁ : (F a).invFun ((F a).toFun (f a)) = f a := by
        apply Equiv.left_inv
      exact h₁
    right_inv := by
      intro f
      funext a
      have h₁ : (F a).toFun ((F a).invFun (f a)) = f a := by
        apply Equiv.right_inv
      exact h₁
  }

def VTask.piCongrRight {α : Sort u_1} {β₁ : α → Sort u_9} {β₂ : α → Sort u_10} (F : (a : α) → β₁ a ≃ β₂ a) : ((a : α) → β₁ a) ≃ ((a : α) → β₂ a) :=
  {
    toFun := fun f a => (F a).toFun (f a)
    invFun := fun g a => (F a).invFun (g a)
    left_inv := by
      intro f
      funext a
      have h₁ : (F a).invFun ((F a).toFun (f a)) = f a := by
        apply Equiv.left_inv
      exact h₁
    right_inv := by
      intro g
      funext a
      have h₂ : (F a).toFun ((F a).invFun (g a)) = g a := by
        apply Equiv.right_inv
      exact h₂
  }
Equiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd:
def VTask.piEquivPiSubtypeProd {α : Type u_9} (p : α → Prop) (β : α → Type u_10) [DecidablePred p] :
    ((i : α) → β i) ≃ ((i : { x // p x }) → β ↑i) × ((i : { x // ¬p x }) → β ↑i) := by
  have h_main : ((i : α) → β i) ≃ ((i : { x // p x }) → β ↑i) × ((i : { x // ¬p x }) → β ↑i) := by
    classical
    -- Define the forward direction of the equivalence
    let forward : ((i : α) → β i) → ((i : { x // p x }) → β ↑i) × ((i : { x // ¬p x }) → β ↑i) := fun f =>
      (fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => f x, fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => f x)
    -- Define the backward direction of the equivalence
    let backward : ((i : { x // p x }) → β ↑i) × ((i : { x // ¬p x }) → β ↑i) → ((i : α) → β i) := fun g =>
      fun x => if hx : p x then
        -- If p x is true, use the first component of g
        (g.1 ⟨x, hx⟩)
      else
        -- If p x is false, use the second component of g
        (g.2 ⟨x, hx⟩)
    -- Prove that the forward and backward directions are inverses
    refine' {
      toFun := forward
      invFun := backward
      left_inv := _
      right_inv := _
    }
    · -- Prove left_inv: backward ∘ forward = id
      intro f
      funext x
      by_cases hx : p x
      · -- Case: p x is true
        simp [forward, backward, hx]
        <;> aesop
      · -- Case: p x is false
        simp [forward, backward, hx]
        <;> aesop
    · -- Prove right_inv: forward ∘ backward = id
      intro g
      -- Prove that the first components are equal
      have h1 : (fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => (backward g) x) = g.1 := by
        funext ⟨x, hx⟩
        simp [backward, hx, hx]
        <;> aesop
      -- Prove that the second components are equal
      have h2 : (fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => (backward g) x) = g.2 := by
        funext ⟨x, hx⟩
        simp [backward, hx, hx]
        <;> aesop
      -- Combine the results to show the pairs are equal
      simp_all [Prod.ext_iff]
      <;> aesop
  exact h_main

Function.Embedding.setValue:
def VTask.setValue {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} (f : α ↪ β) (a : α) (b : β)
    [∀ (a' : α), Decidable (a' = a)] [∀ (a' : α), Decidable (f a' = b)] : α ↪ β :=
  ⟨fun a' => if h : f a' = b then f a else if h' : a' = a then b else f a',
   fun a₁ a₂ h =>
     by
       by_cases h₁ : f a₁ = b <;> by_cases h₂ : f a₂ = b <;>
         by_cases h₃ : a₁ = a <;> by_cases h₄ : a₂ = a <;>
           simp_all [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄]
       <;>
         (try { contradiction }) <;>
         (try {
           have h₅ := f.injective h
           simp_all
         }) <;>
         (try {
           have h₅ : a₁ = a₂ := by
             have h₆ := f.injective
             have h₇ : f a₁ = f a₂ := by
               simp_all
             exact h₆ h₇
           simp_all
         }) <;>
         (try {
           have h₅ : a₁ = a₂ := by
             have h₆ := f.injective
             have h₇ : f a₁ = f a₂ := by
               simp_all
             exact h₆ h₇
           simp_all
         })
   ⟩
List.prev:
def VTask.prev {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ l) : α :=
  let n : ℕ := (l.takeWhile (· ≠ x)).length
  let i : ℕ := (if n = 0 then l.length else n) - 1
  l.get ⟨i % l.length, by
    have h₁ : i % l.length < l.length := Nat.mod_lt _ (by
      cases l with
      | nil => simp_all
      | cons _ _ => simp_all [List.length]
    )
    exact h₁
  ⟩

Nat.clog:
def VTask.clog (b n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if b ≤ 1 then
    0
  else if n = 0 then
    0
  else
    if b ^ (Nat.log b n) = n then
      Nat.log b n
    else
      Nat.log b n + 1

def VTask.clog (b n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h₁ : b ≤ 1 then
    0
  else
    if h₂ : n ≤ 1 then
      0
    else
      let k := Nat.log b n
      if h₃ : b ^ k = n then
        k
      else
        k + 1

def VTask.findGreatest : (P : ℕ → Prop) → [DecidablePred P] → ℕ → ℕ
  | P, _, 0 => 0

    if h : P (n + 1) then n + 1 else VTask.findGreatest P (n)
Nat.nthRoot:
def VTask.nthRoot (n a : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if n = 0 then 1
  else
    let rec find_root (lo hi : ℕ) : ℕ :=
      if hi ≤ lo then lo
      else
        let mid := (lo + hi) / 2
        if (mid + 1) ^ n ≤ a then
          find_root (mid + 1) hi
        else
          find_root lo mid
    find_root 0 (a + 1)

  fun c d ↦ ∃ (a : α) (b : β), r a b ∧ f a = c ∧ g b = d

def VTask.Map : {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> {γ : Type u_3} -> {δ : Type u_4} -> (r : α → β → Prop) -> (f : α → γ) -> (g : β → δ) -> γ → δ → Prop
  := fun {α} {β} {γ} {δ} r f g c d => by
  have h_main : (∃ (a : α) (b : β), r a b ∧ f a = c ∧ g b = d) → (∃ (a : α) (b : β), r a b ∧ f a = c ∧ g b = d) := by
    intro h
    exact h
  exact ∃ (a : α) (b : β), r a b ∧ f a = c ∧ g b = d

  ¬∃ (g : ℕ → α), (∀ m < n, g m = f m) ∧ (∀ i, g i ∈ s) ∧ (¬∀ (i j : ℕ), i < j → r (g i) (g j)) ∧ (rk (g n) < rk (f n))

    (∀ i < n, g i = f i) →
    (∀ i, g i ∈ s) →
    (∀ i j, r (g i) (g j) → i < j) →
